params.name: identifiers
params.description: Protein identifiers to map (names, synonyms, UniProt IDs). Separate multiple identifiers with URL-encoded newline (%0d) for GET requests, or actual newline/carriage-return for POST requests.

params.name: species
params.description: NCBI taxon ID to restrict results to a specific organism. Common values: 9606 (human), 10090 (mouse), 10116 (rat), 7227 (D. melanogaster), 6239 (C. elegans), 4932 (S. cerevisiae), 3702 (A. thaliana), 7955 (zebrafish).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of matches to return per input identifier

params.name: echo_query
params.description: If 1, include the original query identifier in the output

params.name: caller_identity
params.description: A string identifying your application or organization. Strongly recommended; helps STRING admins contact you if there are issues.

items.docs: Map gene names, protein synonyms, or UniProt IDs to STRING identifiers. Use the returned STRING IDs in subsequent API calls for best performance.
Map gene names, protein synonyms, or UniProt IDs to STRING identifiers. POST is recommended for queries with many identifiers.
